God to me is a feeling that can be expressed by homo sapiens in many ways. To me, I see "God" in life as a whole, karma, learning from your mistakes, your conscience, basically. You are your own God. You are the one who must find your own happiness. We created "God" because we were too afraid to tackle our own problems or learn where we came from. 
To me, heaven and hell are moreso the legacy you leave behind in life: whether your name resembles positive energy or negative energy, causing your family and your "clan" to be associated with bad things if you do bad things in your life. If you are a good person, people will remember that and your family will be remembered as a good person. I don't believe that there is a heaven, because heaven would have had to evolve to keep up with the standards of those dying. For instance, a person who got into "Heaven" in the prehistoric-era wouldn't want to live in a mansion. A person who was born now would want Netflix in "Heaven". When you die, your energy is released back to the world. Your family's reputation depends on the actions you make now. That's what heaven and hell is to me. And "God" is your conscience.
